method: Each of seven PNGs was separately opened with view_image at original detail and inspected directly. Supplied implementation images are supplemental; fresh independent images establish the tested states.

inspected_images.observations: Dark screen at narrow width. Heading, input and Add wrap without clipping. One loaded row and Submissions: 1 are visible; Restricted wraps onto its own line.
Dark mobile screen with readable loaded row. New todo input and Add fit on one line, as do the four action buttons. No visible right clipping.
Dark desktop screen with the existing left-aligned neutral fixture, readable controls, one loaded row and submission counter.
Dark 320px screen shows one milk row with a blue checked checkbox and Submissions: 1. Controls wrap, all labels remain visible, and no content is visibly clipped at the right edge.
Dark 390px screen shows checked milk and Submissions: 1. Input/Add and action buttons fit within the viewport with readable labels.
Dark desktop screen clearly shows checked milk, one submission and all existing controls; the neutral fixture layout is preserved.

The modal fits within 320px and visibly shows Clear all todos?, Cancel and Confirm clear. Cancel has a clear blue focus outline. The background retains the draft kept during modal and checked milk row.

verdict: PASS for the requested neutral fixture visual scope at 320, 390 and 1280px, including the inspected mobile modal state.
limitations: Images cannot by themselves establish keyboard, history, hidden DOM or request isolation; those are recorded separately in qa-result.json.
Only Firefox on this macOS environment and the captured viewports were inspected; this is not a screen-reader or cross-browser audit.
This visual result does not accept issues 22 or 23 as a whole.
